Name: Comparable (check convergence)/Jämförelsesats (Jämförelsetest)
Basic relationship:
f and g continous [a, b), $math{0 <= f(x) <= g(x)} for [a, b)
1. $math{\int{a, b, g(x)dx}} convergent -> $math{\int{a, b, f(x)dx}} convergent
2. $math{\int{a, b, f(x)dx}} divergent -> $math{\int{a, b, g(x)dx}} divergent

Geometric:
$math{I_f: \int{a, b, f(x)dx}, I_g: \int{a, b, g(x)dx}}
$math{M_f = {(a, y): x in (a, b), y in [0, f(x)}, M_y = {(x, y): x in (a, b), y in [0, g(x)]}}
$math{f(x)<=g(x) -> M_f \subset M_g}, I_g convergent -> M_g finite -> M_f finite -> I_f convergent
I_f divergent -> M_f infinite -> M_g infinite -> I_g divergent

Name: Rational/Radical expression
Presetted values:
$math{\int{1, \inf, x^98/(x^100+x^10)dx} <= \int{1, \inf, x^98/x^100dx}} -> convergent
$math{\int{1, \inf, 1/(x^10+[x^7+x^3+1])} < \int{1, inf, 1/x^10}} -> convergent
$math{\int{0, 1, 1/(x+sqrt(x))dx} < \int{0, 1, 1/sqrt(x)dx}} -> convergent
$math{\int{0, \inf, 1/sqrt(x^4+2)dx} < \int{0, \inf, 1/sqrt(x^4)dx}} -> convergent
$math{\int{1, \inf, 1/(x+sqrt(x)dx} > \int{1, \inf, 1/(x+x)dx}} -> divergent

Name: Exponential expression
Basic relationship:
1. Compare with managable exponential expressions (geometrical sums)
2. Compare and reduce to managable power forms

Name: Limit Comparison Criterion/Limit Comparison Test/jämförelsekriteriet på gränsvärdesform

Presetted values:
$math{\int{\pi, \inf, sin(x)/xdx} = {\pi, \inf, [-cos(x)/x]} - \int{\pi, \inf, cos(x)/x^2dx}} -> convergent
$math{\int{\pi, \inf, |cos(x)/x^2|dx} <= \int{\pi, \inf, 1/x^2dx}} -> convergent -> $math{\int{\pi, \inf, cos(x)/x^2dx}} -> convergent

Name: Conditional convergence
Basic relationship: $math{\int{a, b, |f(x)|dx}} divergent -> $math{\int{a, b, f(x)dx}} conditionally convergent

Name: Integral and series
Basic relationship:
Positive increasing: $math{\int{1, N, f(x)*dx} <= \S{k=1, N, f(k)} <= \int{1, N, f(x)*dx} + f(N)}
Positive decreasing: $math{\int{1, N+1, f(x)*dx} <= \S{k=1, N, f(k)} <= \int{1, N, f(x)*dx}}

Name: Integral test/Cauchys jämförelsesats (Integralkriteriet)
Basic relationship:
f positive continous and decreasing x>=1
$math{\S{k=1, \inf, f(k)} -> \int{1, \inf, f(x)dx}}

$math{\S{k=0, \inf, a_k}} convergent -> $math{lim{k->\inf, a_k} = 0}
$math{lim{k->\inf, a_k} != 0} -> $math{\S{k=0, \inf, a_k}} divergent

Name: Cauchys rotkriteritum
Basic relationship: $math{\S{k=0, \inf, a_k}, lim{k->\inf, (a_k)^k} = A < 1} -> convergent, A>1 -> divergent

Name: d'Alemberts kvotkriteritum
Basic relationship: $math{\S{k=0, \inf, a_k}, lim{k->\inf, |(a_(k+1))/(a_k)|} = A < 1} -> convergent, A>1 -> divergent

Name: Leibnitz' kriteritum
Basic relationship:
Alternating series/Alternerande serie
$math{\S{k=0, \inf, a_k}, |a_(k+1)|<=|a_k|} -> $math{lim{k->\inf, a_k} = 0} -> convergent
